name: unfleece
description: Free, private PDF tools — your files never leave your browser.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rust && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:rust && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:wasm: cd core && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../src/lib/wasm/pkg --out-name unfleece_core --release && rm -f ../src/lib/wasm/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name unfleece --branch main --commit-dirty=true
